facts.fact: 梦续：Julian 追苍白四足兽入黑湖→黑洋→满天风暴——兵营大厅十二张床全有人、金光刺眼（帘被刻意敞开「so that no shadows could breed」）。
facts.anchor: Julian followed the pale, four-legged beast through an ever-expanding blackness

facts.fact: 床底墨须爬向窗户、日光一寸寸熄灭；暗影从角落溢血般涌出（星瞳在监视）——睡着的人们胸口却亮起辐射状光纹。
facts.anchor: Like a childhood nightmare come to life, inky tendrils slithered from beneath

facts.fact: 屠杀：黑发生物（黑发及背、血手在墙上划出经线）如指挥师把手指点成悬空剑——滴手，血泊漫地（金斑：a curse that resonated in his own veins）；十二心跳齐灭。
走廊对峙：存有上半脸覆星云、星冠罩眼——「YOU'RE HERE... I DIDN’T EXPECT YOU HERE」——声如自宇宙最外缘拖出。
Julian 不问身处何地，只问她好不好——她的声音换成 midnight voice：「I was thinking of you...Wondering if I would ever see you again」；他握上冷剑「Come with me」——「Tae—」被暗影摔上金墙。
facts.anchor: Instead he asked, “Are you all right?”

facts.fact: 她抓他下颌、黑指甲挑破嘴角如模仿虔敬：「Retaliation is coming. Do not fall to them.」——「Those who will destroy you. IF I DO NOT DESTROY THEM FIRST.」
醒来：枕上血渍+肺部电感——地震前、Godsnight 前同款锐压；今日春分；骨镯脉动。
facts.anchor: Julian woke with a bloodstain on his pillow.

facts.fact: 送别：他叫醒母亲，让她去 Hunters compound 找 Kerala（「one last favor from me」）、带药带厨刀；吻手作别——「in apology, in farewell」。
facts.anchor: He took her hand to kiss it—in apology, in farewell.

facts.fact: 奔告：天空绯红、太阳升速反常、glare 减弱——他血脉里的 Orsus 残质示警；Mardova 门前卫兵拦人（Tomás），正午悬停不动。
facts.anchor: The sun was moving far too quickly

facts.fact: 章末：太阳表面裂开水平缝、撕开世界材质——一只巨大的眼睁开，苍白目光钉住下方的 Nexus。
facts.anchor: revealing a massive eye that fixed its pale stare on Nexus far below.
